summary: A recent deployment (dep-5101) introduced a new MarginCheckValidator that does not guard against a null marginProfile. Accounts lacking this field trigger a NullPointerException, resulting in a sharp rise in HTTP 500 errors on order-service. No config changes or upstream service errors were observed. The evidence strongly supports the bad_deployment hypothesis.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Bad deployment introduced NullPointerException in margin validation
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The v2.14.0 deployment added a MarginCheckValidator that assumes a non‑null marginProfile; for accounts lacking this data the validator throws a NullPointerException, causing HTTP 500 responses.

causal_chain.claim: validator accesses marginProfile without null check -> NPE
NPE propagates as HTTP 500, raising error_rate

ranked_hypotheses.title: Data issue: missing marginProfile for a subset of accounts
ranked_hypotheses.statement: An upstream change to the account data store stopped populating the marginProfile field for some accounts; order-service receives null and throws a NullPointerException.
assumptions: Missing upstream logs or metrics showing marginProfile omission
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Insufficient evidence to rule out deployment bug; lower confidence

facts.statement: The incident began shortly after the order-service deployment at 12:10 UTC.

recommended_actions.action: Rollback order-service to the previous version (v2.13.x) or hot‑fix the MarginCheckValidator to handle null marginProfile.
recommended_actions.rationale: Stops the NPE and restores normal order placement.

recommended_actions.action: Add a null‑check for marginProfile in the new validator and add unit tests covering missing data.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents recurrence if the data issue persists.

recommended_actions.action: Investigate upstream account data pipeline for missing marginProfile fields; add monitoring/alerts for null values.
recommended_actions.rationale: Closes the data‑gap identified in hypothesis H2.

data_gaps: No logs or metrics from the service that provides account marginProfile data, preventing confirmation whether the null values are due to upstream data loss.
